name: Silicon Rosenheim AI Factory - Traunstein data-center zones
notes: Public social posts describe one AI hub with four data-center zones, including two in Landkreis Traunstein, and EUR 50B private investment; no permitting, site, utility interconnection, or official municipal filing found in targeted searches, so treat as unverified/vaporware until corroborated.

name: Polarise AI Data Center Amberg-Unterallgäu
notes: Official Polarise/WV Energie announcements say an AI data center is planned in the municipality of Amberg in Landkreis Unterallgäu, starting mid-2027 at 30 MW with scalability up to 120 MW on the former Wertachtal shortwave transmitter site.

name: Hetzner Ellingen data center and solar farm proposal
notes: Ellingen public information materials gave an end-state power requirement around 50 MW and DCD reported a 50 ha scheme with 15 ha for data-center buildings plus 35 ha solar; 2026 NN reporting says Ellingen rejected Hetzner's data-center siting while Treuchtlingen is still seeking an operator.

name: Hetzner Gunzenhausen operations / headquarters site
notes: Hetzner is headquartered in Gunzenhausen and its official history traces the company from local server capacity to datacenter parks elsewhere; local 2026 reporting notes construction of a new Gunzenhausen headquarters after an earlier local data-center effort failed. Included as regional operator/operations footprint, not a confirmed hyperscale data-center build.

name: IDF / Landkreis Wunsiedel county data center
developer: Innovations- und Dienstleistungsgesellschaft Fichtelgebirge mbH (IDF) / Landkreis Wunsiedel
notes: County/IDF pages state IDF is establishing a data center for Landkreis Wunsiedel in Wunsiedel to meet local IT system needs; capacity and completion date were not disclosed.

name: Smartes Fichtelgebirge school data-center cluster
notes: Official Smartes Fichtelgebirge article described planned high-performance server/data-center installations at school centers in Marktredwitz and Selb and around the Landratsamt, aimed at local school IT independence; approximate cost EUR 1M, capacity not reported.

name: SWW Wunsiedel Schneebergturm data center concept
notes: Regional reporting says SWW Wunsiedel planned a data center at the Schneeberg tower site; older Kurier reporting also quoted SWW leadership saying the Schneeberg buildings were well suited for a data center. No capacity or construction confirmation found.

name: Rockenstein Würzburg / Veitshöchheim data centers
notes: Rockenstein's official colocation page states it provides certified data centers in Germany; its contact/certification pages place the company at Schleehofstraße 16, 97209 Veitshöchheim in Landkreis Würzburg. Data Center Map lists Rockenstein Wurzburg at that address. Capacity not disclosed.

name: DC:MAIN Datacenter Mainfranken
notes: Official DC:MAIN site identifies the regional Würzburg data center/operator; DCHub reports Datacenter Mainfranken in Würzburg as operational with 3.0 MW power capacity. Capacity comes from third-party database.

name: euNetworks Colocation Wuerzburg
notes: PeeringDB and data-center directories list an active euNetworks colocation facility at Hertzstrasse/Hertzstraße 2, 97076 Würzburg; Datacenters.com reports 4,306 sq ft raised floor and ISO 27001, but no power capacity.
